annotations.title: SSL and Domain Expiry Sweep: Renewal Dates for Many Domains

description: Check SSL certificate and domain registration expiry for one domain or a whole list: certificate issuer, valid from and to, days left, trusted or not, domain registration and expiry dates, registrar and nameservers. Flags what expires within your warning window. Registrant details are never returned. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

checks.description: Which checks to run for each domain.

domain.description: One domain, for example example.com. Use this or domains.

domains.description: Up to 100 domains in one run (Apify Actor only). Each domain that returns a result is one billable result.

warnDays.description: Flag certificates and registrations that expire within this many days.
